notes.title: The 2017 update is at your doorsteps!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229750/8c9ffdfe929bd7de0237f716648de2d90393914f.jpg[/img]
For the beginning of 2017 we've got:
- Magic marker graphic mode (with colored markers).
- A very cool NEON mode (you can reach out and touch them glowing lines).
- 16BIT mega-cd mode (complete with blast processing and an amazing 320X224 high definition graphics).
- Gamepad rumble!

notes.title: A surprise update has appeared!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229750/a4fce0d5368421d711471fec1e1d9641a54acfe0.png[/img]

Thanks to the guys playing the game and participating in the community we removed the launcher, now the game has full controller support and can be launched with a gamepad! 

The launcher dialog can still be accessed:
- in windows, you hit Alt an instant after clicking Play and the config window will pop up (do not hold Alt while clicking Play).
- in Ubuntu launch the game through command line adding these parameters 
[b]-show-screen-selector[/b]
- in macOS it should work with Command, but i'm yet to test it :P

notes.title: September update is here!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229750/c31ce4fdf04e298d2c444891b7f36d5936c0d835.png[/img]
September is here, or should i say 32th of August?

The biggest update is the [b]image based lighting[/b] giving a much softer and deeper look to the whole game!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229750/5139e91bccc713619665342a2235be04072e1a24.jpg[/img]

Collectible trading cards have been added (cards, badges, foil badge, profile backgrounds, emoticons...)

33% off the Steam price for the first couple of weeks (bringing it down to $2) active since 10am today!

Since the Desktop version is so far ahead now the iOS and Android versions are now free forever. They still have their own charm, so if you want to play on the go, try the LCD game or just enjoy the music for a while, visit the mobile stores. The mobile version has absolutely no ads, no iaps, no catch whatsoever!

Thank you all for the support and for playing!!

notes.title: SCORE PLUS is here!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229750/fdaea9fed7dbcd58acf327075586398f162875d6.png[/img]
In this new version of the game the following scoring systems are in place:
- Buzz [near miss] bikes for 20 000 points each
- Perfect run on level 01 gives 100 000 points
- Consecutively a perfect run on level 02 gives 200 000 points
- Up until level 10 where you get 1 000 000 points
- bonding gives 16 000 ~20 000 points a second
- keeping the bond for 20 seconds gives +800 000 points
- The regular score multiplier for going on TURBO is still in place

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229750/1a517c2932605019f7ac130d927f793531c3163f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: July Update! New gameplay mode. Controller optimizations.
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229750/c12a371b9634fc5c0c21ec2aaf064aa46e779657.png[/img]

- All popular Dual analog controllers should work on Windows, macOS (MFi), Linux, steamOS.
[i]If you experience any problems, please post on the boards the brand of your pad and i'll add support asap.[/i]

- A new gameplay mode adds points for passing close to enemy bikes for a chance at bigger scores. Each near-miss gives 1000 points and believe me, the game gets much more interesting without being harder.

Thank you!
